name: How do I know if project management is working well on my project?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if project management is working well on my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear communication, few surprises, documented decisions, visible progress aligned with the schedule, and well-managed handoffs between phases are strong indicators that project management is effective.
